simba.Codes.Bmad.Bmad module

SIMBA Bmad Module

Various objects and functions to handle Bmad lattices and commands. See Bmad manual and Tao manual for more details.

Classes:

  • bmadLattice: The Bmad lattice object, used for converting the frameworkObject s defined in the frameworkLattice into a Bmad lattice, and for tracking through it using PyTao.

class bmadLattice(**data)[source]

Bases: frameworkLattice

Class for defining the Bmad lattice object, used for converting the frameworkLattice into a Bmad lattice, and for tracking through it using PyTao.

Parameters:

data (Any)

apply_programs(turn)[source]

set element each programmed element’s attribute for turn.

Called from inside the Tao turn loops, which are the only place Bmad tracks a line more than once here.

Parameters:

turn (int) – Turn number, 1-based

Return type:

None

chromaticity_delta: float

Momentum step for the Bmad chromaticity finite difference. Matches Tao’s own delta_e_chrom default.

code: str

String indicating the lattice type

input_beam_file: str | None

Input beam file name

lattice_file: str | None

Lattice file name

libtao: str | None

Location of libtao.so

otm_convention: ClassVar[str] = 'x, px, y, py, z, pz'

One-turn map convention.

otm_longitudinal_scale: ClassVar[int | None] = 0

this is the convention the others convert to.

Type:

Canonical by definition

otm_longitudinal_sign: ClassVar[int] = 1

One-turn map longitudinal sign (i.e. R56)

particle_definition: str | None

Initial particle distribution as a string

postProcess()[source]

Retrieve the outputs from Bmad and save them to master_subdir, and the twiss parameters along the lattice in HDF5 format.

Return type:

None

preProcess()[source]

Get the initial particle distribution defined in file_block[‘input’][‘prefix’] if it exists.

Return type:

None

program_attributes: ClassVar[dict] = {'ac_kicker': ('bl_hkick', 'bl_vkick'), 'hkicker': ('kick', 'kick'), 'kicker': ('hkick', 'vkick'), 'vkicker': ('kick', 'kick')}

(horizontal, vertical) Bmad attribute an unqualified program sets, per element type.

radiates_by_default: ClassVar[bool] = True

Flag to state that Bmad radiates by default (based on LAURA).

read_closed_orbit()[source]

Tao’s orbit.vec.N at the start of the lattice.

read_one_turn_map()[source]

Tao’s matrix with the same element at both ends.

Tao documents that as the one-turn map, which only means anything on a geometry = closed lattice – the condition periodic() already gates on.

Returns:

The 6x6 mat6, or None if Tao gave nothing back.

Return type:

numpy.ndarray | None

read_optics_summary()[source]

Tune and chromaticity from Tao.

Chromaticity is dQ/ddelta, so it is measured the way it is defined: shift the closed orbit to +/- delta with set particle_start pz and difference the tunes.

Return type:

dict

ref_idx: int | None

Reference particle index

ref_s: float | None

S position at the start of the lattice

run()[source]

Run the code via PyTao.

Return type:

None

run_dynamic_aperture()[source]

Tao’s dynamic-aperture scan, read back through the raw pipe. Needs lattice apertures to work.

Returns:

(x, y, turns_survived) along the aperture boundary. As with elegant this is a boundary rather than a survival grid, so the turn count is turns() for every point on it.

Return type:

list

run_frequency_map()[source]

Tune footprint by tracking the grid turn by turn through Tao.

Track one turn, read the bunch at END, write it back into beam_init%position_file and repeat; see _track_grid_turn_by_turn().

Returns:

(x, y, tune_x, tune_y, diffusion) per surviving grid point.

Return type:

list

space_charge_n_bin: int | None

Number of space-charge bins

supports_dynamic_aperture: ClassVar[bool] = True

Tao’s own scan, configured by a &tao_dynamic_aperture namelist in the init file; see _tao_dynamic_aperture_namelist().

supports_frequency_map: ClassVar[bool] = True

By tracking the grid a turn at a time and feeding the bunch back through beam_init%position_file; see _track_grid_turn_by_turn(), which records why the hand-back cannot go through set beam beginning.

supports_periodic: ClassVar[bool] = True

parameter[geometry] = closed, which LAURA writes from the section’s own geometry; Bmad then takes the Twiss from the one-turn map.

supports_programs: ClassVar[bool] = True

By set element inside the Tao turn loops; see apply_programs().

supports_radiation: ClassVar[bool] = True

bmad_com[radiation_damping_on] and [radiation_fluctuations_on], which LAURA writes from the section’s own sr_enable/isr_enable.

tao: Any | None

PyTao instance

tao_init_file: str | None

Tao initialization file name

track_reference_particle()[source]

One particle, recorded every turn, through the same beam loop the frequency map uses.

Reuses run_frequency_map()’s machinery with a one-point grid.

Return type:

dict

Create the lattice file using the LAURA SectionLatticeTranslator and save it to master_subdir.

None
